prol_narr_0002.mp3.chinese: 夏天。城堡的庭院里长满了野草，蒲公英的白色绒毛在午后的阳光中飘荡。你追着它们跑，光着脚踩在温热的石板上。
prol_narr_0002.mp3.english: Summer. The castle courtyard overflows with wild grass, and the white down of dandelions drifts in the afternoon sun. You chase after them, barefoot on the warm stone.

prol_narr_0003.mp3.chinese: 世界很大。大到你跑不到尽头。
prol_narr_0003.mp3.english: The world is vast, stretching beyond the farthest reaches one can run.

prol_narr_0004.mp3.chinese: 庭院的另一边，卫兵们在换岗。铠甲碰撞的声音清脆而有节奏，像某种你听不懂的音乐。你停下来看他们，直到一个老卫兵朝你咧嘴一笑。
prol_narr_0004.mp3.english: On the other side of the courtyard, the guards were changing shifts. The clinking of armor was crisp and rhythmic, like a music you couldn't quite understand. You paused to watch them, until an old guard grinned at you.

prol_narr_0005.mp3.chinese: 你没理他，继续追蒲公英。五岁的你还不懂什么叫规矩。
prol_narr_0005.mp3.english: You ignored him and continued chasing the dandelions. At five years old, you knew nothing of rules.

prol_narr_0006.mp3.chinese: 傍晚，女仆玛尔塔把你从庭院里捞回来，浑身是土。她一边给你擦脸一边唠叨。
prol_narr_0006.mp3.english: At dusk, the maid Martha fetched you from the courtyard, covered in dirt. As she wiped your face, she chattered on.

prol_narr_0007.mp3.chinese: 你不知道格雷伯爵是谁。你只知道他的儿子费利克斯很胖，上次来的时候偷了你的木剑。
prol_narr_0007.mp3.english: You do not know who the Earl of Grey is. You only know that his son, Felix, is plump and stole your wooden sword the last time he visited.

prol_narr_0008.mp3.english: On the second day, Felix arrived.

prol_narr_0009.mp3.chinese: 他比你高半个头，圆滚滚的脸上带着一种你日后才学会辨认的表情——轻蔑。他身后跟着两个随从家的孩子，像两条尾巴。
prol_narr_0009.mp3.english: He stands half a head taller than you, his round face bearing an expression you would only learn to recognize later—contempt. Trailing behind him are two children of his retinue, like twin tails.

prol_narr_0010.mp3.chinese: 你没说话。你确实不敢骑马。但你不想让他知道。
prol_narr_0010.mp3.english: You said nothing. Indeed, you were afraid of riding a horse. But you did not wish for him to know.
